items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: I called up Oscar, I said, Oscar, be ready for the Saturday night, we're going over the lake.

ctx.x: Yes, I got it. Ask Oscar.

I called up Oscar, I said, Oscar, be ready for the Saturday night, we're going over the lake. I take Oscar over there. See, knew that Oscar's glad to make that money. I said, man, next time you got to get me, call on me. You understand me? Well, he's a man, he realized, a man's giving you a piece of bread, and you're trying to do him. Do you call yourself my friend? No. Eh? As much as them fellas really been around here, yet they, they don't get no jobs. And, thanks I get jobs from some big people. I get jobs,…
Do the colored people like this old style of music, do you think they really like it now?
